title: Add a read-only preview before GitHub sync
context: Settings currently exposes a direct GitHub repository sync action even though KernelSession already supports a preview-only operation that computes upload, download and delete plans without applying changes.
goal: Expose the existing read-only sync preview in Settings so users can inspect the planned changes before choosing the separate sync action.
forbidden_changes: Do not change GitHubRepositorySyncClient conflict detection or filesystem mutation logic.
Do not make preview mutate workspace files, remote refs, or baseline state.
Do not store or display the GitHub token in status text.
acceptance_criteria: Settings has a Preview changes action that calls session.syncGitHubWorkspace(preview: true).
Preview and sync actions cannot run concurrently and are disabled while an action is in progress.
Preview results are displayed in the existing status surface.
The action label is localized in English and Vietnamese.
verification: Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA workflow
Confirm preview dispatch uses preview: true and normal sync retains the default path
recovery: Revert the single task commit if preview invokes the mutating sync path or Apple build fails.
